Kt.bar_b_note: A's dark-brown body with a domed green carapace reads as one naturalistic creature, but B's orange-red dog in a strapped-on plate blanket looks like a kitbash, and the flat neutral stage gives no Valheim-class light to carry either.

Ro.bar_b_note: B's patterned hide gives Palworld-level surface interest, but A's flat unmarked olive skin, both sides' sooty faint-end backs and the gold rather than pink frills keep it short of the Mirejaw board finish.

Zk.bar_b_note: B's Tanglevolt holds the owner-bar fur and violet palette through every pose, but A's faint mid/end frames turn into a white body with black blobs, and that broken material sinks the set.

Wt.bar_b_note: The reticulated hide on B is the side that earns its finish; A's smooth flat olive and the near-black rolled-over backs at faint end on both sides read below the owner creature bar.

Ko.bar_b_note: Standing frames have naturalistic fur, real tusks and good bulk against the ruler, but the faint mid/end frames collapse to a near-black, splayed shape, and A's orange-red ember seams push toward the reserved red.

Nd.bar_b_note: This set is visually identical to Kt: A's integrated carapace creature is close to shippable, while B's orange-red coat and saddle-like plate pad read as a dog in armour rather than one creature.

Uh.bar_b_note: The patterned side (A) carries surface detail and the plain olive side (B) reads flat-shaded, and on both the faint-end back goes sooty-black on a bare stage with no atmosphere.

Xn.bar_b_note: B's timber frame with a diagonal brace, plank cap and stone footing now reads as built, but it is still a lone thin panel with flat tan infill, standing beside a faceted grey low-poly boulder under flat, shadowless light and a painted-backdrop horizon.

Rm.bar_b_note: This is the same split as Ro and Uh: the markings on A give the creature a hide, B's plain olive reads untextured, and both go sooty when rolled over in faint end and swim on a flat untextured blue plane.

Zy.bar_b_note: The clean stylised elder (white hair and beard, readable eyes, moss-green vest and scarf, brown trousers) matches Palworld's human-NPC finish and the key art's warm natural palette; the sides are indistinguishable at this resolution.

top_changes.change: Fix the hurt/faint material and lighting path: Zk A's faint frames swap to a white body with black blobs, Ko's faint frames and the Mirejaw faint-end backs go near-black. Keep the standing material and add rim/fill so rolled-over backs stay mid-value.

Mirejaw (Ro/Wt/Uh/Rm): drop the flat-olive variant and recolour the patterned variant to a warm olive-umber base with lighter, softer markings (less black reticulation), moving the gold frills toward the board's pink/coral.

Kt/Nd and Xn: commit to the integrated chestnut-brown carapace creature (side A), and give the B homestead wall real thickness, a textured wattle/plaster infill, contact shadow and a world-matched boulder beside it.
